Former Minister's Letter on Fertilizer Sparks Controversy

A former minister has written to the Chief Minister requesting urea fertilizer, using a term for farmers that has caused controversy. The Chief Minister has reportedly removed the mandatory requirement for NPK fertilizer along with urea, a decision impacting farmers in areas like Guna.
